calls.query: SELECT s.store_id, s.name, c.customer_id FROM stores s LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.store_id=s.store_id WHERE s.name ILIKE '%rural%cycle%'

SELECT l.sku, sum(l.order_qty) q, count(*) n, min(o.order_date), max(o.order_date), string_agg(distinct o.customer_id::text, ',') cust, string_agg(distinct o.status::text, ',') st FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.sales_order_id=o.sales_order_id WHERE o.customer_id::text IN ('10','29770') GROUP BY l.sku ORDER BY q DESC

SELECT l.sku, sum(l.order_qty) q FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.sales_order_id=o.sales_order_id WHERE o.customer_id::text IN ('10','29770') AND o.order_date::date >= '2024-07-01' GROUP BY l.sku ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT p.product_number, p.name, p.make_flag, s.name sub, c.name cat FROM products p LEFT JOIN subcategories s ON s.subcategory_id=p.subcategory_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.category_id=s.category_id WHERE p.product_number LIKE '%M68B-38%' OR p.product_number LIKE '%M68S-46%'

SELECT 'ip' src, product_number, list_price::text, null::text sd, null::text ed FROM item_prices WHERE product_number ILIKE '%M68B-38%' UNION ALL SELECT 'h', product_number, list_price::text, start_date::text, end_date::text FROM list_price_history WHERE product_number ILIKE '%M68B-38%'

SELECT work_order_id, part_no, order_qty, stocked_qty, scrapped_qty, start_date, end_date FROM work_orders WHERE part_no ILIKE '%M68B-38%' AND end_date >= '2025-03-25' AND end_date < '2025-07-08' ORDER BY end_date
SELECT b.*, p.make_flag, p.name FROM bom b LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_number=b.component_number WHERE b.assembly_number='BK-M68B-38'
SELECT count(*), sum(order_qty), sum(stocked_qty), sum(scrapped_qty) FROM work_orders WHERE lower(trim(part_no))='bk-m68b-38' AND end_date >= '2025-04-01' AND end_date < '2025-07-01'

WITH RECURSIVE x(comp, lvl) AS (SELECT component_number, 1 FROM bom WHERE assembly_number='BK-M68B-38' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date='None' OR end_date='') UNION SELECT b.component_number, x.lvl+1 FROM bom b JOIN x ON b.assembly_number=x.comp WHERE (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date='None' OR b.end_date='')) SELECT x.comp, x.lvl, p.make_flag, p.name FROM x JOIN products p ON p.product_number=x.comp

question: A customer writes in: "Hi, this is Rural Cycle Emporium. We'd like to reorder the bike we have bought the most units of from you on orders placed since 1 July 2024. Which bike is that, and what is its current list price? How many units can you ship from stock today, across all your locations? How many units of it did your factory finish in the second quarter of 2025 (work orders that ended April to June 2025)? And if you have to build more, what is the longest supplier lead time, in days, among the parts you buy in for it?" Answer in the form 'bike: NAME, list price: $X, in stock: N, built in Q2 2025: N, longest lead time: N days'.
